title: Clinical Drift Monitor: skin lesion classification with drift detection, and OMOP research tables from public dermoscopy archives
description: Code for a portfolio project on public research images: a skin lesion classifier served with an out-of-distribution score, a Databricks lakehouse that builds OMOP CDM v5.4-style tables from HAM10000 and ISIC Archive metadata, a governed cohort service with small-cell suppression, and the evaluation protocol. No images or dataset downloads are included. The ID lists, concept map and per-image predictions that are included keep their sources' licenses (CC-0, CC-BY, CC-BY-NC), cited in docs/DATA_CARD.md. Not a clinical tool.
